latestVersion.changelog:
freelance-invoice-tracker 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Automatically tracks invoices for Indian freelancers using Google Sheets.
- Sends automated follow-up reminders via email and WhatsApp based on overdue tiers.
- Calculates GST per invoice and generates monthly income and GST summaries.
- Provides commands for invoice status, payments, and client summaries.
- Notifies freelancers of overdue invoices and upcoming GST filing deadlines.
- Integrates with Gmail/SMTP and supports daily/monthly reporting.
